name: Placester
description: Placester is a real-estate website and marketing platform with IDX sites, lead-capture forms, a simple CRM, autoresponders, drip campaigns and integrations.
agentUseSummary: Placester is visible as a security-review preview. Relay will not collect a customer-owned Zapier webhook URL or receive website lead data until Placester approves a signed, least-privilege third-party integration contract.

capabilities.label: Review bounded Placester lead intake
capabilities.description: If Placester approves a signed least-privilege contract, expose only exact-site, privacy-redacted lead intake tools after security review.

blocked.label: Capture a Placester webhook URL
blocked.description: Relay will not request or store a customer-owned Zapier webhook URL for this preview.

blocked.label: Receive private Placester lead data
blocked.description: Website form submissions, names, email addresses, phone numbers, property interests and other prospective-client data are unavailable.

blocked.label: Automate forms or lead emails
blocked.description: Replacing Placester emails, generating saved-search emails, forwarding submissions and changing CRM or marketing workflows are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run Placester actions before security review
blocked.description: No Placester tool is callable until Placester documents signed delivery, replay protection, stable schemas and event IDs, exact site binding, lifecycle, limits, auditing and distribution terms.

approvalProfiles.label: Placester webhook security review
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable because the documented custom integration forwards sensitive website lead data to a customer-owned webhook without a public signed-delivery contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable under Placester's documented customer-owned webhook flow.
No Hermes tools are callable under Placester's documented customer-owned webhook flow.

providerSetup.blocker: Placester's public Custom API instructions configure outbound website form delivery through a customer-owned Zapier webhook URL. Public materials do not establish provider-issued third-party authentication, granular scopes, immutable site and account claims, signed webhook verification, replay protection, stable event schemas and identifiers, delivery lifecycle, revocation, limits, auditing or general distribution approval.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask Placester to approve Relay as a production third-party integration and provide signed webhook verification, replay protection, stable versioned schemas and event IDs, exact site and account binding, delivery retry and revocation lifecycle, limits, privacy-redaction requirements, audit identifiers and distribution terms. Re-run privacy and security review before implementing typed bounded lead-intake tools.

evidence.supports: Placester's Custom API instructions use a customer-created Zapier webhook URL to receive website form submissions and show that payloads can include names, email addresses and project information.
Placester's current integration catalog presents the Custom API alongside named partner integrations and describes it as forwarding website lead data.
Placester's CRM stores lead and contact details, saved and favorite listings, and supports contact import and export, making lead delivery privacy-sensitive.
Placester currently markets IDX websites, lead capture, CRM and email, live chat, agent management and native integrations for real-estate teams.
Placester publishes service terms; Relay must not infer third-party API or webhook distribution rights beyond the public integration instructions.
Placester publishes privacy terms for its service and hosted websites; any future lead-intake connector requires explicit data-minimization, retention and consent review.
